name: Pixel Union
summary: Premium Shopify themes bought once rather than by subscription, from Pixel Union and its sister brand Out of the Sandbox. A theme is a starting point — the conversion lift comes from how you configure and populate it, not from the purchase.
best_for: online retailers and larger-catalog stores that want a professionally designed, conversion-focused Shopify storefront without paying for custom development
skip_if: a free or low-cost Shopify theme already covers your needs, or you have a developer building a bespoke storefront anyway
honest_knock: A premium theme is a strong starting point, not a finished store. The conversion lift comes from how you configure, populate and optimize it -- a $360 theme on a store with weak product pages or slow images still converts weakly. Heavily customized premium themes can also be more work to keep updated and can add page weight if you switch on every feature. Buy it for the design system and speed-to-launch, not as a magic conversion switch.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: Read on 7 September 2026, re-read on 12 September 2026 and again, unchanged, on 27 September 2026. The theme pages on pixelunion.net print the price in plain text beside the 'Try theme for free' button, and the store's own product feed and the JSON-LD offer on those same pages carry the same figures, so all three agree: every theme is a one-time purchase in USD, Startup $100, Editions $120, Grid $280, Atlantic $300, Empire $360 and Tailor $360. That is a change between our two readings -- on 7 September the theme pages showed the button and no amount, and the price was readable only in the store's product data. The Shopify Theme Store lists Empire at the same $360 USD. Sister brand Out of the Sandbox, sold from outofthesandbox.com, runs from $220 (Responsive, Retina) and $240 (Launch, Pacific) through $260 (Parallax), $320 (Superstore) and $425 (Turbo) to $495 (Flex) and $499 (Amphora, Merlot, Vino); those amounts are from the 7 September reading and were not re-checked. The one recurring charge in the group is an optional Priority Support Subscription at $96 a year, auto-renewing, covering Pixel Union, Archetype, Clean Canvas and Out of the Sandbox themes.

compare_with.name: Shopify's own free themes or a custom build
compare_with.why: free themes are fine for simple stores; premium themes like these buy design depth and features you'd otherwise build by hand
